unit: first observation per ticker and UTC observation day
target_definition: One primary target and recipe must be locked on development data before the test starts; no outcome-based switching.
selection: All saved public Scanner picks in the fixed trading-day window; no outcome or score threshold filter
stopping_rule: Fixed end, never extend or shrink based on results. If sample is insufficient, report inconclusive.
outcome_access: Collector never reads outcomes. Development loaders exclude the entire reserved time interval before reading outcomes. Future evaluation requires a separate locked recipe and explicit release implementation.
model_policy: Keep production AI Confidence unchanged. Lock target, feature schema, model, parameters and evaluation settings by December 22 before test starts; no automatic evaluation.
amendment: Before registration or collection: November 13 capture audit found only 10 RSI/regime days from November 2. User prioritized new inputs. First 20 fresh sessions are development, followed by a separate future test after label maturity and embargo. No forward outcomes were inspected.
